exposure: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) use (real-time or intermittent scanning)
outcome: Achievement of glycemic target of HbA1c <7.5%
cohort: Registry participants aged <18 years with Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) duration >=1 year from the US-based type 1 diabetes Exchange Registry (T1DX) and the German/Austrian DPV (Prospective Diabetes Follow-Up Registry).
finding: Pediatric CGM use increased from 2011 to 2016 in both registries and was associated with lower mean HbA1c regardless of insulin delivery modality.
